title: NexGo Ride Standard (v0.2.0 draft)
description: Successor draft to nexgo-ride.v0.1.0. Replaces the single passenger-asserted raw ride blob with THREE typed assets forming a real on-chain handshake: ride-request (passenger, geohash-bucketed for privacy), ride-offer (DRIVER-signed on the driver's own sigchain, with a quoted fare), and ride-agreement (passenger accepts a specific offer; fare LOCKED and bound to the invoice). Switched to JSON format so requests are queryable for p2p geo-sharded discovery. Atomic invoice settlement is kept. See docs/nexgo-cluster-design-note.md.
maxSize: 1KB per asset (system fields ~180 bytes, ~820 bytes for data).

assetTypes.description: Passenger's open request. Precise pickup is NOT on-chain -- only a coarse geohash bucket; exact pickup is shared p2p after match.

self-addr.description: Queryable copy of this asset's register address; referenced by offers as 'request'.

pickup-geohash.description: Coarse pickup area (geohash, ~6 chars). Precise pickup shared p2p only after a match -- privacy by construction.

max-fare-milli.description: Maximum fare the passenger will accept, in milli-units of 'currency'.

expires-ts.description: Unix expiry; drivers ignore expired requests.

assetTypes.description: DRIVER-signed offer on the driver's own sigchain -- the on-chain consent handshake missing from v0.1.0.

self-addr.description: Queryable copy of this asset's register address; referenced by the agreement as 'offer'.

request.description: self-addr of the ride-request being bid on.

driver.description: Driver NAMESPACE (the asset owner -- the offer is driver-signed).

vehicle.description: self-addr of the driver's nexgo-taxi asset.

quoted-fare-milli.description: Offered fare in milli-units of 'currency' (must be <= request.max-fare-milli).

assetTypes.description: Passenger accepts a specific driver offer; fare is LOCKED and bound to the invoice. References both request and offer self-addrs.

self-addr.description: Queryable copy of this asset's register address; referenced by the rating as 'agreement'.

offer.description: self-addr of the accepted driver-signed offer (proves mutual consent).

fare-milli.description: Locked fare in milli-units; the Nexus invoice amount must equal this.

invoice.description: Reference to the Nexus invoice (atomic DEBIT + CLAIM settlement).

trip-hash.description: Optional hash of the off-chain p2p trip record (evidence for disputes); coordinates stay off-chain.

steps: 1. Passenger creates ride-request (geohash buckets, max-fare, status=open).
2. Drivers discover via geo-scoped on-chain query and create DRIVER-signed ride-offers (quoted-fare <= max-fare).
3. Passenger picks one offer and creates a ride-agreement referencing request+offer; fare locked. Exact pickup shared with that driver over p2p.
4. Driver creates a Nexus invoice for fare-milli; passenger pays atomically (DEBIT + CLAIM); agreement status=paid.
5. Trip occurs; live location over direct encrypted p2p (no coordinates on-chain). On completion, status=completed (+ optional trip-hash).
6. Passenger may submit a nexgo-rating referencing the agreement self-addr (verified-ride gating).

examples._comment: Open ride-request (coarse geohash buckets, no precise coordinates).

queryFilters.openRequestsNearby: distordia-type = 'nexgo-ride-request' AND status = 'open' AND pickup-geohash LIKE '{geohash}%'

notes: Driver-signed offer fixes the v0.1.0 trust asymmetry (passenger could not legitimately assert the driver's acceptance).
Fare is agreed BEFORE payment and bound to the invoice -- no more post-acceptance surprise invoicing.
Coarse geohash buckets replace permanent on-chain coordinates; precise pickup is p2p after match.
Discovery is p2p on-chain via geohash-scoped queries; an optional permissionless indexer can cache shards.
Successor draft to nexgo-ride.v0.1.0 (standards/nexgo-ride-standard.json), retained for history.
